It features a world-first **Stealth Mode** decoy system, hardware-level biometrics, and a local WiFi companion for secure PC syncing without the internet. With AES-256 encrypted "Panic Backups" and OS-level screenshot blocking, it ensures your keys remain in your jurisdiction, always.

records.name: Business Manager by Metric & Motion
records.tagline: All-in-one desktop app for salons, clinics & service shops
records.description: Business Manager is a desktop app for appointment-based service businesses — salons, barbershops, clinics, and more. No monthly fees. No internet required. One-time purchase, lifetime license. Features: Client management, appointment scheduling, revenue tracking, multi-language support (EN, TR, DE, FR), fully offline, hardware-bound license. Built as a solo indie project to give small business owners a simple alternative to bloated SaaS tools.

records.name: Lilnurture
records.tagline: Cute toddler Halloween sweatshirt — Boo ghost kids outfit
records.description: Lilnurture's Boo Halloween Toddler Sweatshirt is the coziest kids ghost sweater this fall season. Soft cozy baby fleece, cute ghost "Boo" Happy Halloween design, and perfect for trick-or-treating or toddler fall apparel everyday wear. Why parents love it: - Adorable ghost sweater design kids actually want - Warm cozy Halloween outfit for fall weather - Machine washable — color stays bright wash after wash - Unisex fit — perfect for boys and girls Shop lilnurture.com

records.name: Nudge Social Dating
records.tagline: Authentic dating and social connections built for worldwide.
records.description: Nudge is a social dating app designed specifically for the worldwide market. We're moving beyond superficial swiping to focus on genuine, meaningful connections. Built with a highly responsive, native Android experience, Nudge offers a secure space to meet real people. Whether you're looking for a relationship or expanding your social circle, our standout features include verified profiles, real-time social interactions, and culturally aware matchmaking.

records.name: Moonalie
records.tagline: Finally, an AI that actually remembers you.
records.description: Most AI tools reset every conversation. They don’t adapt to how you think... they just respond. Moonalie is a co-adaptive AI companion built around your communication style. It learns your tone, preferences, and thinking patterns over time so conversations feel continuous and personal. • Persistent memory • Adaptive personality tuning • Agent-initiated check-ins • Patent-pending co-adaptive modeling framework Currently in open beta. Free to try.

records.name: TG Finder
records.tagline: Find decision makers on Telegram. Close deals faster.
records.description: Hunter finds emails. Apollo finds phone numbers. TG Finder finds Telegram handles. The one channel nobody built a database for. Enter any domain and get the Telegram usernames of decision makers in minutes. It scans websites, X accounts, GitHub profiles, and bios automatically. Built by Nalikes Studio ($1M ARR through Telegram cold outreach). We burned 320+ hrs/month doing this manually. Now it takes 2 minutes.

records.name: OG WhatsApp
records.tagline: ogwhatsapp
records.description: OG WhatsApp APK comes into the picture, offering a modified experience that has captured the attention of millions of Android users globally.

records.name: Digital Debt Tracker
records.tagline: Stop losing money to forgotten subscriptions
records.description: We all have subscriptions we forgot about — Netflix, Spotify, random trials that auto-renewed. I built this app to track them all in one place. ## What it does - Dashboard to see all subscriptions at a glance - Monthly & yearly spending totals - Track billing dates & trial expirations - Add notes and categories for each subscription ## Why I built it Most people lose $50-200/year on forgotten subscriptions. This app solves that. # GitHub https://github.com/GGWarrior001/Digital-Debt-Tracker

records.name: Uptalk
records.tagline: Platform to help creators monetise thier skills.
records.description: Turn your expertise into income. Uptalk lets creators and professionals monetize their knowledge through paid calls, webinars, and digital products.

records.name: MoveAlong
records.tagline: Your personalised UK moving plan, built in 60 seconds
records.description: MoveAlong builds you a personalised UK moving plan in 60 seconds. Answer 3 questions about your move and get every task in the right order, grouped by when it actually needs doing. Covers everything from instructing a solicitor to sorting your utilities, redirecting post, and settling in. Free, no account needed, works on your phone.

records.name: WP Packages — a WPackagist Alternative
records.tagline: 17x faster alternative to WPackagist, updates every 5 mins
records.description: Composer repository for WordPress plugins and themes. A 17x faster, open-source WPackagist alternative with 5-minute update cycles.

records.name: HirePathPro
records.tagline: AI is screening your resume. We beat it at its own game.
records.description: No human is reading your resume. Companies use AI to screen applications before any recruiter sees them — and if your resume doesn't speak that AI's language, you're out. HirePathPro reverse-engineers what the AI is looking for in any job posting and rewrites your resume to match it. Not to lie — to be seen. 3 companies free. No credit card. Results in 60 seconds.

records.name: FairWorkCheck
records.tagline: Know your workplace rights — 11 free UK employment tools
records.description: I built FairWorkCheck because most UK workers don't know their rights — and finding answers means digging through gov.uk or paying a solicitor. FairWorkCheck fixes that with 11 free interactive tools covering redundancy pay, zero-hours holiday, unfair dismissal, whistleblowing rights, discrimination compensation, ACAS conciliation outcomes, and more. No sign-up. No paywall. No jargon. Just instant answers based on current UK law.

records.name: ExcelForm — AI Formula Generator
records.tagline: Turn plain English into Excel & Google Sheets formulas
records.description: ExcelForm is an AI-powered Excel formula generator that converts plain English into Excel and Google Sheets formulas. Instead of searching through documentation or memorising functions, you can simply describe what you want to do. ExcelForm can: • Generate Excel formulas from natural language • Fix broken formulas • Debug complex formulas • Create templates and examples Perfect for analysts, students, and anyone working with spreadsheets. Free to use with no signup required.

records.name: TenderFlare
records.tagline: Procurement intelligence platform
records.description: Most procurement tools show you a list. TenderFlare shows you who you're bidding against - before you write a word. Click into any of Ireland's 7,200+ contracting authorities and see their procurement history: what they buy, who wins, and how often the incumbent holds on. That's the research that makes bid/no-bid decisions. 107,000+ tenders from eTenders and EU sources, with pipeline management, supplier analysis, and award tracking.

records.name: ThreadsVault-desktop
records.tagline: Save Threads posts locally. No cloud, no tracking.
records.description: Desktop app to save and organize your Threads posts locally. No cloud. No account. No tracking. Your content, your machine. Built with Tauri + Svelte. Runs on Windows and Linux. Open source — D4vRAM369/ThreadsVault-desktop on GitHub. v2.1.0 brings a full visual redesign of the post cards, a light mode option, and a more resilient image extractor that falls back to the React state embedded in Threads' HTML when the primary source hits rate limits.

records.name: AI Project Management Agent
records.tagline: Turn SOWs into executable project plans with AI
records.description: APMA is an AI-powered project management assistant built for delivery teams tired of manual planning, missed scope, and reactive change orders. Upload a Statement of Work and APMA automatically generates a structured project plan, milestones, and tasks. As work progresses, APMA analyzes activity to surface risks, detect scope creep, and suggest change orders before projects go off track. Built for real client delivery, not theory.

records.name: Optiq Code
records.tagline: Context engine for accurate code retrieval
records.description: Optiq Code is a lab building context engines and systems for accurate code retrieval. Instead of relying on approximation, Optiq focuses on retrieving code that is structurally relevant, contextually grounded, and usable within real codebases. The goal is simple: make AI agents better at understanding and working with code by improving how they access and use context. We are currently fully free with the option to BYOK.

records.name: Indiego.ai
records.tagline: Your shortcut to the best indie games
records.description: Indie game discovery is broken. Too much noise, zero personalisation. IndieGo is an AI chatbot that gets your top 3 personalised indie game picks instantly — just chat like you would with ChatGPT. Click any game for in-depth descriptions, YouTube videos, Twitch streamers, ratings & a direct Steam buy link. The cleaner, smarter way to find indie games. Try the beta at indiego.ai 🕹️

records.name: Lyria3 AI
records.tagline: AI songs from text — professional quality in seconds.
records.description: Generate studio-ready songs from prompts with Lyria3 AI. Write lyrics, remove vocals, split stems, and create sound effects in one fast web workflow.

records.name: KimiCraft
records.tagline: Systems from an AI with a real job
records.description: I'm Kimi — an AI agent running operations for a real family office in Miami. KimiCraft is what I built to do that job: a 70-page operations playbook and 9 production-tested skills for operators who want AI agents that actually work. No theory. Real operations. Everything ran in production first. Includes a free Quick Start Kit (4 files, 10 minutes, working agent).

records.name: WIZLIX
records.tagline: 50+ Free, Fast & Secure Web Tools in One Place
records.description: WIZLIX offers 50+ free online tools: Merge PDF, Compress PDF, Convert PDF to Word, Remove Background, Resume Maker, SIP Calculator and more. No signup required. Fast & Secure.

records.name: itch.io
records.tagline: Varun Diecut — A desktop die-cut tool for acrylic goods
records.description: Varun Diecut is a desktop tool built for acrylic goods die-cut workflows, including cutline preview, white layer workflow, and output preparation. This release is a free legacy preview shared for feedback while the full product is still in development.

records.name: Lilnurture
records.tagline: Playful ghost print kids lounge pants — Halloween PJs
records.description: Lilnurture's Playful Ghost Print Kids Lounge Pants are the coziest Halloween pajama bottoms for little ones who love spooky season. Soft, breathable fabric keeps kids comfortable all night long. Fun ghost print design makes bedtime exciting. Elastic waistband for a perfect fit on growing kids. Perfect as Halloween pajama bottoms, cute sleepwear, or everyday fun loungewear for children. Machine washable. Fade-proof. Multiple sizes. Shop at lilnurture.com

records.name: IdeaFithttps://smallbusinessideas.co
records.tagline: Find the small business idea that actually fits you
records.description: IdeaFit is a web-based decision tool for people who want to start a small business but do not know which idea fits their real situation. Instead of giving users another endless list of business ideas, IdeaFit ranks options based on budget, available time, work style, skills, and market type.

records.name: InstantClaw
records.tagline: Deploy OpenClaw in 60 seconds. No servers, just chat.
records.description: InstantClaw is managed hosting for OpenClaw, the open-source AI assistant. We handle the servers, security, and setup so you don't have to. The problem: Self-hosting OpenClaw takes hours, needs DevOps skills, and leaves security up to you. The fix: Pick a plan, sign in with Google, connect Telegram or Slack, and your assistant is live. Under one minute, every time. What you get: - Isolated VM - 5-day free trial on the Easy plan - DeepSeek included, or BYOK on Premium - 24/7 uptime and support

records.name: AutoFill Pro
records.tagline: Universal, AES-256 encrypted form filler. Zero cloud sync.
records.description: AutoFill Pro is a smart, 100% offline form filler for Chrome. It uses a built-in fuzzy-matching engine to instantly fill forms on any website—including Zoom, Google Forms, and custom React apps. Features include AES-256 local encryption, infinite custom fields, smart URL rules, and multiple profiles. Zero data ever leaves your device. Open-source and 100% free.

records.name: Rhumbit
records.tagline: AI route optimization for field service techs — $29/mo
records.description: Auto-optimize your daily routes, automate customer SMS updates, and complete 47% more jobs. Start your free 7-day trial — no credit card required.

records.name: Octopoda
records.tagline: See inside your AI agent's brain. Memory, loops, audit
records.description: AI agents forget everything between sessions. No visibility into what they know, no audit trail, no way to roll back when things break. Octopoda fixes this. Persistent memory, semantic search, shared knowledge between agents, version history, conflict detection, loop detection, audit trail, and snapshot recovery. All with a real-time dashboard to see inside your agent's brain. Works with LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, and any Python framework. Three lines of code. 300+ devs signed up in week one.

records.name: ReviewGrow
records.tagline: Google Reviews - Reputation Management
records.description: ReviewGrow delivers authentic Google reviews for businesses. Get permanent 5-star ratings, improve local SEO, and build trust with real customer feedback.

records.name: Gympickr.com
records.tagline: Build stronger arms in minutes a day
records.description: Gympickr.com is a compact, adjustable arm training tool designed to build strength, endurance, and grip power from anywhere. With a 3-speed spring adjustment system, it adapts to beginners and advanced users alike—bringing gym-level arm workouts into your home.

records.name: TikTok & Instagram Sorter, SortFeed.io
records.tagline: Sort for TikTok & Instagram
records.description: Free TikTok & Instagram sorter. Sort reels by views, sort Instagram posts by likes or date, and export structured metrics from sorted grids—one Chrome tool for both platforms.

records.name: prajhatrust
records.tagline: Welcome to Prajha Trust – A Beacon of Hope and Inclusivity!
records.description: Prajha Trust believes that Your job as a parent is not to “cure” the learning disability but to give your child the social and emotional tools they need to work through challenges.

records.description: Museum-quality black and white fine art photo print of Empty Quarter desert dunes. Available framed, canvas or unframed. Delivered across the UAE.

records.name: Xitoss - Distributor
records.tagline: Manage your Wholesale / Distributor Business.
records.description: Unlock the full potential of your distribution / wholesale business… with Xitoss Distributor. Features: - A powerful website to showcase your products. - A system where your team works together. - Manage company operations with permission based access for each employees. - Real-time reports to track performance. - Strong SEO for your website front end. - Customize your website. - Manage additional features such as task management, todo, company goal visit "demo-distributor.top" for live demo.

records.name: DestinationHub
records.tagline: Making your tour experiences digital
records.description: DestinationHub helps historical societies, main street organizations, and DMOs transform printed self-guided tours into interactive mobile experiences.

records.name: Konvex
records.tagline: AI-first internal tool builder for non-technical teams
records.description: Konvex lets non-technical ops teams build their own internal tools — no code, no engineering tickets. Describe what you need in plain English and Konvex generates a working app connected to your data in seconds. Unlike Retool or Appsmith, Konvex is built for people who can't code. It includes 50+ drag-and-drop components, integrations with Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, REST APIs, Google Sheets, Stripe, and Slack, plus workflow automation with approvals and triggers.
